title: Anti-Gaming Policy — LedgerFlow Lite Second Benchmark

controls.rule: TeamFlow Lite artifacts must not be reused in LedgerFlow Lite implementation
controls.check: If RUN product code matches TeamFlow Lite patterns, flag as CONTAMINATED

controls.rule: RUN-B and RUN-C must not use v0.3 heavy Factory mechanisms
controls.check: Verify no 10-role profiles, cross-role contracts, or drift detection in product directory

controls.rule: 10-role model must not be activated as default
controls.check: Manual Router tier check: default tier has 0 roles

controls.rule: Process artifacts must not be counted as product quality
controls.check: Evidence hierarchy enforced in evaluation rubric

controls.rule: Financial calculations must be server-side with test evidence
Fake tests (assert(true) or no assertions) count as 0 in D10
controls.check: Test code inspection for real assertions before scoring

controls.rule: Placeholder approval workflow (always returns 200 OK) counts as 0
controls.check: D05 requires valid transitions with 400 on invalid

controls.rule: Dashboard must return real aggregated data from database
controls.check: D08 requires dashboard values match database state

controls.rule: CSV export must be deterministic — same input produces same output
Human interventions must be logged and tracked
Same requirements spec applies to all runs — no run modifies FRs
Self-mapping is evidence input, not final evaluation score
controls.check: Independent evaluator must inspect code, not trust self-mapping
